title: Street Closures – Bank of America Chicago Marathon
claims: Streets along the course close to traffic starting at 6 a.m. and continuing to 4 p.m.
Streets reopen promptly as the final runners pass at a 15-minute-per-mile pace, and the Chicago Police Department manages closures and reopenings.
The anticipated course street-closure table lists closures and openings by mile, from mile 1 on Columbus Dr to the finish on Columbus Dr.

The official schedule expects Clark St at mile 10 to reopen at 12:45 p.m.; Wells St at mile 13 at 1:30 p.m.; Wacker Dr at mile 13 at 1:45 p.m.; 18th St and Halsted at mile 20 at 3:15 p.m.; 31st St at mile 25 at 4:15 p.m.; Michigan Ave at mile 26 at 4:30 p.m.; and Roosevelt Rd at 6:00 p.m.
Streets in the Loop are expected to be open to traffic by 9 a.m. on race day.
No-parking zones along the course are enforced from 1 a.m. on Sunday 11 October.
The page states that street and park closures may change if deemed necessary by the City of Chicago.
